jobs.description:
Department Operations

LevelEntry Level

LocationSingapore

The Operation teams at Shopee covers the operational end-to-end process, from when the buyer searches for a product listed on the Shopee platform, to the moment the buyer receives the products. The team analyses and monitors operational KPIs across the region and conducts root cause analysis when operation performance fluctuates. The Operations team comprises Customer Service, Payment, Listings, Warehouse, Logistics, Seller Operations and Fraud.

About the Team:

At Shopee, logistics is the backbone of connecting millions of buyers and sellers across Southeast Asia. As a Strategy and Operations Analyst, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping this massive network—designing data-driven solutions that make deliveries faster, warehouses smarter, and operations more cost-efficient.

Leveraging data, analytics, optimisation models, and collaboration with cross-functional teams, you’ll drive innovations that directly influence strategy and transform the user experience at scale.

You may work on projects such as:

* Designing the transportation network, deciding the optimal number and location of hubs and warehouses
* Developing warehouse layout strategies to improve productivity and throughput
* Modelling inventory placement across the network to reduce lead times and costs
* Comparing air, sea, and land transportation modes for cost-effectiveness and speed
* Projecting end-to-end supply chain costs under different demand and volume scenarios
* Optimising last-mile delivery strategies for both urban and rural regions
* Evaluating the role of automation and technology in future network design
* Conducting scenario analysis to understand the impact of disruptions, fuel price changes, or labour constraints

Job Description:

* Process Strategy & Optimisation: Evaluate and refine logistics processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen operational scalability.
* Data Analysis & Insight Generation: Analyse diverse and dynamic datasets on operations and user behaviours, uncovering insights that tackle complex, real-world challenges. Use modelling and analysis to identify trends and generate insights that inform high-stakes business decisions.
* Strategic Support: Align strategic projects with broader business goals by supporting discussions with stakeholders and helping to define clear operational objectives.
* Planning & Execution: Help translate strategic goals into actionable plans with defined steps, contributing to their successful implementation.
* Performance Monitoring: Track the results of new initiatives, providing data and observations to help the team identify successes and areas for further refinement.
* Project Coordination: Provide support on cross-functional projects, helping with coordination and communication to keep initiatives on track.

Requirements:

* Currently pursuing or has completed a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a reputable university with strong academic credentials. Candidates who are currently pursuing their Bachelor’s Degree should be expected to graduate by Jul 2027, and all candidates must be able to join us by Aug 2027.
* Candidates who meet the above requirements and are currently pursuing a Master’s Degree or above must be able to join us on a full-time basis by Aug 2027. A Master’s Degree or above is advantageous but not required.
* Proficiency in SQL and Python, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Prior experiences in operations analytics, data analytics, or data-driven roles, internship or full-time.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking skills, with a knack for turning complex problems into practical solutions.
* Ability to explain technical findings clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Collaborative, adaptable, and excited to work in a high-growth environment.
  

Please indicate your expected graduation date (MMM/YY) and earliest available start date (MMM/YY). Candidates who do not provide this information may be contacted to verify the details before being considered for shortlisting.
  
  
Kindly note that you can only be considered for one role at a time with any of the companies within our Group. If you have applied for other jobs with the Group, you will be considered for roles in the order of your application.

The **Logistics Analyst** supports the end-to-end execution of air freight forwarding spot quotes. The role receives and reviews internal rate requests, determines whether contracted pricing is available and applicable, sources spot pricing when required, calculates the complete transportation cost, and coordinates with internal stakeholders and freight forwarders through quote selection and move execution. The analyst works across multiple procurement, sourcing, rate-management, reporting, and communication systems while maintaining accurate, timely, and audit-ready records.

**What You Will Do:**

* Manage assigned air freight rate requests from intake through closure, including Requests For Information (RFIs) and time-sensitive actual-move spot requests. Requests will be generated from internal and external sources.
* Review shipment details for completeness and accuracy, including origin and destination, requested service level, service type, commodity, dimensions, actual weight, chargeable weight, shipment date, special handling requirements, and required delivery timing.
* Research contracted rates, routing guides, rate validity dates, approved service levels, lane coverage, and allowable accessorial charges to determine whether an existing contract applies.
* Validate calculations and commercial terms against approved rate sources; identify missing, expired, conflicting, or non-applicable rates and escalate exceptions when needed.
* Create and maintain rate-request records across multiple systems, which may include Salesforce, RateCloud, Keelvar, Power BI, Excel, Teams, email, and other internal tools.
* Prepare and issue RFIs to support planning or cost-estimate decisions, clearly documenting assumptions and advising requestors that pricing may require revalidation before shipment execution.
* Launch actual-move spot requests to qualified air freight forwarders, communicate complete shipment requirements, establish response deadlines, monitor supplier responses, and follow up to meet shipment timing.
* Compare supplier offers for pricing, transit time, routing, capacity, service level, validity, exclusions, and operational feasibility; request clarification or revised offers when information is incomplete or inconsistent.
* Calculate the total expected move cost using the applicable chargeable weight, freight rate, minimum charges, fuel, security, pickup, delivery, handling, customs-related, special-service, and other approved accessorial charges. Normalize currencies and units of measure when required and document all assumptions.
* Provide requestors with a clear quote comparison and recommendation that identifies total cost, provider, routing, transit time, quote validity, assumptions, exclusions, and risks. Protect supplier pricing from unauthorized external disclosure.
* Collaborate with trade-lane teams, facilities, dealers, factories, procurement colleagues, operations teams, freight forwarders, and other internal and external partners to resolve questions and support timely spot-move execution.
* After a quote is selected, confirm award details with the appropriate parties; obtain and record the house air waybill or other booking reference; complete required approval documentation; and update the request through final closure.
* Maintain complete supporting documentation, including requests, quotes, calculations, approvals, correspondence, booking details, and exception rationale, in accordance with process, compliance, and audit requirements.
* Track open requests, priorities, response times, aging items, savings or cost avoidance, and exception trends; escalate urgent, high-risk, or stalled requests promptly.

* Strong analytical ability and attention to detail, with demonstrated accuracy in rate validation, cost calculations, and data entry.
* Ability to manage multiple requests, systems, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while clearly prioritizing urgent actual moves.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, filters, comparisons, and structured cost analysis; working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Ability to learn and navigate procurement, sourcing, rate-management, CRM, and reporting platforms.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**  
Work closely with business users, product owners, solution architects, developers, and testing teams to translate business needs into clear and implementable functional requirements.
  
  
Responsible for understanding business processes, analysing requirements, identifying gaps and dependencies, and producing functional specifications that guide solution design, development, testing, and implementation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Requirements Gathering & Analysis:**  
Engage business stakeholders and users to understand business objectives, processes, pain points, and requirements.
  
  
Facilitate requirements gathering, clarification, and grooming workshops.
  
  
Analyse high-level business requirements, service journeys, user stories, and existing processes.
  
  
Break down high-level requirements into detailed functional requirements and system behaviours.
  
  
Identify requirement gaps, ambiguities, assumptions, dependencies, and business rules.
  
  
Maintain requirements traceability from business requirements through design, development, and testing.
  
  
**Business Process & Functional Design:**  
Analyse and document current-state and future-state business processes.
  
  
Develop process flows, use cases, user journeys, functional flows, and system interaction diagrams.
  
  
Define business rules, decision logic, validations, exception handling, and processing scenarios.
  
  
Work with solution architects and technical teams to ensure functional requirements can be translated into appropriate technical solutions.
  
  
Prepare and maintain Functional Design Specifications (FDS) or equivalent functional documentation.
  
  
**User Stories & Acceptance Criteria:**  
Develop and refine epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria where applicable.
  
  
Ensure requirements are sufficiently detailed and testable before development.
  
  
Support estimation and planning by clarifying functional scope and dependencies.
  
  
Work with developers and testers during implementation to address requirement clarifications.
  
  
**Integration & Data Requirements:**  
Define system interface and integration requirements with relevant teams.
  
  
Analyse input/output data requirements, field mappings, validations, and processing rules.
  
  
Support interface specification reviews and identify upstream/downstream dependencies.
  
  
Clarify API, batch, file, or system integration behaviours from a functional perspective.
  
  
**Testing & Implementation Support:**  
Support QA and UAT teams in developing test scenarios and ensuring requirement coverage.
  
  
Review test cases against functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Support defect triage and determine whether issues are defects, requirement gaps, or change requests.
  
  
Provide functional clarification during SIT and UAT.
  
  
Support implementation readiness, cutover, and post-production validation where required.

Act as the functional bridge between business and technology teams.
  
  
Manage requirement clarifications, decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and open issues.
  
  
Coordinate with business users, technical teams, external systems, and vendors.
  
  
Ensure functional documentation remains current throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Support requirements walkthroughs, design reviews, and stakeholder sign-offs.

2-4 years of experience.

Onsite working arrangement.

Strong requirements elicitation and analysis skills.
  
  
Ability to translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications.
  
  
Good understanding of the software development lifecycle.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Good stakeholder management and communication skills.
  
  
Ability to work effectively with business users, architects, developers, testers, and project managers.

Experience with large-scale enterprise or government system implementation.
  
  
Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
  
  
Experience with BPMN, UML, or other process modelling techniques.
  
  
Basic understanding of REST APIs, system integrations, databases, and data mapping.
  
  
Experience supporting SIT, UAT, production implementation, and defect management.
  
  
**Key Competencies:**  
Structured and analytical thinking.
  
  
Strong attention to detail.
  
  
Ability to identify and challenge ambiguous requirements.
  
  
Good facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills.
  
  
Ability to understand both business and technical perspectives.

jobs.description:

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The **Logistics Analyst** supports the end-to-end execution of air freight forwarding spot quotes. The role receives and reviews internal rate requests, determines whether contracted pricing is available and applicable, sources spot pricing when required, calculates the complete transportation cost, and coordinates with internal stakeholders and freight forwarders through quote selection and move execution. The analyst works across multiple procurement, sourcing, rate-management, reporting, and communication systems while maintaining accurate, timely, and audit-ready records.

**What You Will Do:**

* Manage assigned air freight rate requests from intake through closure, including Requests For Information (RFIs) and time-sensitive actual-move spot requests. Requests will be generated from internal and external sources.
* Review shipment details for completeness and accuracy, including origin and destination, requested service level, service type, commodity, dimensions, actual weight, chargeable weight, shipment date, special handling requirements, and required delivery timing.
* Research contracted rates, routing guides, rate validity dates, approved service levels, lane coverage, and allowable accessorial charges to determine whether an existing contract applies.
* Validate calculations and commercial terms against approved rate sources; identify missing, expired, conflicting, or non-applicable rates and escalate exceptions when needed.
* Create and maintain rate-request records across multiple systems, which may include Salesforce, RateCloud, Keelvar, Power BI, Excel, Teams, email, and other internal tools.
* Prepare and issue RFIs to support planning or cost-estimate decisions, clearly documenting assumptions and advising requestors that pricing may require revalidation before shipment execution.
* Launch actual-move spot requests to qualified air freight forwarders, communicate complete shipment requirements, establish response deadlines, monitor supplier responses, and follow up to meet shipment timing.
* Compare supplier offers for pricing, transit time, routing, capacity, service level, validity, exclusions, and operational feasibility; request clarification or revised offers when information is incomplete or inconsistent.
* Calculate the total expected move cost using the applicable chargeable weight, freight rate, minimum charges, fuel, security, pickup, delivery, handling, customs-related, special-service, and other approved accessorial charges. Normalize currencies and units of measure when required and document all assumptions.
* Provide requestors with a clear quote comparison and recommendation that identifies total cost, provider, routing, transit time, quote validity, assumptions, exclusions, and risks. Protect supplier pricing from unauthorized external disclosure.
* Collaborate with trade-lane teams, facilities, dealers, factories, procurement colleagues, operations teams, freight forwarders, and other internal and external partners to resolve questions and support timely spot-move execution.
* After a quote is selected, confirm award details with the appropriate parties; obtain and record the house air waybill or other booking reference; complete required approval documentation; and update the request through final closure.
* Maintain complete supporting documentation, including requests, quotes, calculations, approvals, correspondence, booking details, and exception rationale, in accordance with process, compliance, and audit requirements.
* Track open requests, priorities, response times, aging items, savings or cost avoidance, and exception trends; escalate urgent, high-risk, or stalled requests promptly.
* Follow export-control, confidentiality, procurement, sourcing, record-retention, and air freight forwarding requirements. Identify opportunities to improve templates, system data quality, turnaround time, and spot-quote reporting.

**What You Have:**

* Strong analytical ability and attention to detail, with demonstrated accuracy in rate validation, cost calculations, and data entry.
* Ability to manage multiple requests, systems, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while clearly prioritizing urgent actual moves.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, filters, comparisons, and structured cost analysis; working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Ability to learn and navigate procurement, sourcing, rate-management, CRM, and reporting platforms.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to request missing information, summarize quote options, document assumptions, and coordinate with stakeholders across functions and regions.
* Working knowledge of air freight concepts such as chargeable weight, dimensional weight, service levels, origin/destination pairs, transit time, routing, quote validity, and accessorial charges preferred.
* Sound judgment in recognizing rate discrepancies, operational risks, incomplete data, and situations requiring escalation.

**Additional Info:**

* This position requires working onsite five days a week.

The role helps translate business needs, regulatory requirements, operational challenges, and stakeholder objectives into clear requirements, actionable insights, reporting solutions, and process improvements.

* Support process documentation, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities.
* Contribute practical ideas that improve reporting, governance, resilience, and operational practices.

jobs.description:
Project Description:

This internship offers an exciting opportunity to help centralise engagement records across 106 government agencies. Our feedback and engagement data currently reside across various formats, including Excel sheets, Word documents, and emails stored on SharePoint.

Project Objective:

The objective is to consolidate this into a single platform (Databricks) to enable the team to query and analyse it effectively, and to establish a pipeline for new data to be ingested on an ongoing basis.

The core of the work involves reviewing our existing engagement data, understanding its structure and content, and preparing it for ingestion into Databricks.

The intern will use AI tools to assist with the extraction and transformation of unstructured data, and will help establish a repeatable pipeline so that future data from SharePoint can be ingested systematically. Once the data is in place, the intern will also support the team in exploring how it can be queried to surface insights, such as identifying agencies with common interests or recurring feedback themes.

The intern will also be expected to surface new insights from having a holistic view of our data.

  
  
**Requirements**

We welcome applicants from any discipline, including social sciences, public policy, business, and information studies. This role does not require a background in computer science.

What we value most is someone who is organised, detail-oriented, and able to think carefully about how information should be structured to be useful to a non-technical team.

Some familiarity with Excel and basic data handling is expected. Prior experience with Python, SQL, or SharePoint would be advantageous but is not a requirement.

Experience in ETL processes or database management would be an advantage, though candidates without this background are equally welcome to apply. The intern will be expected to pick up Databricks as part of the role.

MUFG Bank, Ltd., Singapore Branch is seeking a Junior Contract Analyst to provide day-to-day operational and administrative support to the Sales desk and related stakeholders in the processing of Treasury transactions, including Foreign Exchange (FX), FX Options and Derivatives. This is a junior-level contract role suitable for candidates who are detail-oriented, eager to learn and interested in building practical experience in banking operations and financial markets support.

* Support the Sales desk and Operations department in checking and inputting FX and FX Option deals into the Bank’s systems under guidance from senior team members.
* Assist in ensuring transactions are processed accurately and within required timelines.
* Coordinate with the Sales desk, Product Office and Operations teams to clarify transaction details and support routine issue resolution.
* Assist with system-related enhancement and implementation activities by performing testing support, data checks or documentation updates as required.
* Input data into relevant systems accurately and maintain data integrity across operational processes.
* Prepare routine reports, data summaries and other operational materials to support functional activities and management reporting.
* Respond to routine internal queries in a timely manner and escalate non-routine or complex matters to senior team members.
* Perform basic verification of Treasury transaction details to support compliance with MUFG policies, internal procedures and applicable local regulations.
* Assist in preparing reports, presentations and data analysis under the guidance of more experienced team members.
* Provide general project implementation support, engaging with relevant stakeholders as required.
* Develop a working knowledge of relevant Treasury products, industry practices, regulations and internal standards.

----------------

* Diploma or Degree in Banking, Finance, Business, Economics or a related discipline. Fresh graduates or candidates with limited relevant experience may be considered.
* Internship or early-career experience in banking operations, Treasury operations, Sales support, trade support or financial markets operations will be advantageous.
* Basic knowledge of FX, FX Options, Derivatives or other Treasury products is preferred but not mandatory.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and ability to follow procedures in a controlled environment.
* Good communication skills and willingness to work with Front Office, Operations, Systems and Head Office stakeholders.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Able to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating effectively in a team-oriented environment.
